notes.title: The demo is available again!
notes.notes:
Hi!

The demo is available again but this time it will stay for a while. 

I hope you'll give it a try if you haven't already! Remember that you can send feedback or bugs via social networks or via Steam (in the support or in the game's group).

Remember to follow The Neroe on Steam so you don't miss anything and add it to your wishlist so you'll be notified in its launch.

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: The demo event is over!
notes.notes:
Hi.

Today the demo will be deactivated. I hope you enjoyed it!

If you didn't get a chance to try it out, don't worry. You will have more opportunities to play the game in the future, so don't forget to follow The Neroe in Steam.

You can also add the game to your wishlist or follow on social media.

Thanks to all of you who have tried it and thank you for reading!

notes.title: Demo available from 2 May until 9 May!
notes.notes:
Hey!

Today will be available a demo of the game, so you can try it!

The Neroe isn't yet finished, so you may experience issues, sorry if this is the case!

If you find bugs, errors or whatever, please contact me via Steam (the "Support" button in the Steam Library) or via Social Media. I will fix it as soon as possible.

You can also contact me with suggestions. I will keep them in mind.

Thank you for reading and enjoy the game!
